notes.title: November 21, Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 🤫

Today we have another patch for you! This one includes general improvements as well as plenty of fixes. 

Stay quiet; survive another day. 



Improvements


Quality of Life & Accessibility 


 The game journal functionality now allows players to display journal entries locally (from the current walkthrough) or globally (from any walkthrough), preventing spoilers unless specifically enabled.
 Physical interactions for objects thrown into the water were added.
 Improved support for all resolutions, including ultrawide. 
 The position of the inhaler icon and sound level meter icon in the inventory have been standardized for consistency.
 New options for greater customization in the main menu were introduced to the graphics settings.
 A menu toggle now lets players select their preferred sound effects for the creatures.
 The timer for non-blocking tutorials was adjusted to minimize interference with gameplay.
 An additional tutorial for the microphone was added for better clarity.
 The timing for planks breaking when players stand on them was refined.
 Balancing
 The AI in Easy Difficulty was adjusted to make the level more accessible for less experienced players.
 AI behaviour was balanced to prevent it from staying too close to the player too frequently.
 Optimization
 Improved performance when RTX is turned on.



Issue Fixes


Creature AI


 Aggressive AI behaviour near the Camper Parking bottle trap at the Campsite was resolved.
 AI at the Pool area of the Fire Station level no longer gets stuck on PC. 
 AI navigation issues at the Harbor’s "CityEnter" and shipyard areas were addressed. 
 AI at the Hospital's "Garage" hide-and-seek zone now turns properly at the start of the sequence. 
 Aggressive AI overpassing the environment during Bear Trap encounters at the Campsite was corrected. 



General Fixes


All Platforms  


 Subtitles are no longer displayed when the "Subtitles" setting is turned off  
 There is no longer a shortcut through the pallet in the last hide-and-seek zone in the Forest level. 
 Sand is now being poured correctly throughout the game. 
 The plank can`t be moved through the air vent at the "Canal" area at the Pump Station. 
 Hint markers no longer float if the camera moves before the hint disappears. 
 The letters of the Radio Station sign are no longer reflected on the wall at the Campsite. 
 Creature animations no longer clip with the environment during Bear Trap sequences at the Campsite. 
 Trigger input is no longer ignored the first time on rope traps' skill checks. 
 The countdown to the achievement/trophy "A Fast Swim" now starts after Alex activates the sprinklers in the pool at the Fire Station level. 
 The unmuted microphone icon no longer displays incorrectly during starting level sequences. 
 The space shuttle collectible is now easier to retrieve after the Watchtower at the Campsite. 
 It is now easier to interact with a specific rope trap in the "Parking" area at the Campsite.
 Diary progress now resets correctly when starting a new game. 
 Vertical deadzone for the left stick in the Game Menu was adjusted for better navigation. 
 Save creation issues at the Harbor level’s "Pier" area were addressed. 
 Selecting "Survivor Mode" now sets "Hint Type" to "Objective Only," hiding Locator hints. 
 Button prompts for picking up the mixtape in "Theater" mode now display correctly. 
 The mic icon will now show muted status during document interactions. 
 Narrative sequences now mute the microphone as expected when activated. 
 Difficult interactions with ropes and tunnels were adjusted for ease. 
 Alex can no longer avoid boxes by climbing a car at the Campsite’s start.
 Achievements/trophies "Art Lover" and "Passionate" now unlock after the first purchase of art and models in the game with pre-order content ON PS5 and Xbox. 


PC Only


 The restore default button button is now disabled if options are already on default in video options. 
  Chromatic aberration is turned off by default on 4K monitors.
  HWRT is no longer active on low presets. 
  Letters on button prompts now display correctly when the keyboard layout is switched to Cyrillic. 
 DLSS no longer creates artifacts across the game.


PlayStation 5 Only


 Exiting to the main menu during the final cinematic before the credits now correctly unlocks the Concept Art for The Fire Station. 
 Reactivating the microphone no longer reactivates vibration feedback on the DualSense controller. 


Xbox Series X|S Only


 Diary menu navigation issues were resolved. 



Audio & Visual Fixes


All Platforms


 Objects with physics now have improved animations and sounds when falling into the water at the Pump Station level. 
 Lighting in the Trainwreck cave now remains consistent regardless of player distance. 
 Floating leaves on the Market Roof at the Harbor level were corrected. 
 Animation clipping during Bear Trap sequences was resolved at the Campsite. 
 Floating seams in the Harbor level buildings and Pump Station Sewers ground were fixed. 
 The visible seam on the ground at the Pump Station's Sewers checkpoint has been fixed. 
 Overlapping sand textures on the inhaler after the Forest’s first gap were resolved. 
 Creature animations no longer clip with the environment during special cases at the Campsite. 
 Creature foot-slip animations during a jump to the deposit were fixed at the Campsite. 


PC Only


 Low-resolution UI elements in Options and the "Skip" progress fill bar were improved when "Texture Quality" is set to Low. 


PlayStation 5 Only


 Car shadows no longer blink in Quality mode on IIS for PS5. 


Xbox Series X|S Only


 Game Over screen text resolution was enhanced on XSX.
 Red light rendering with "Protanope" Color Correction Type on XSX now behaves consistently. 



That’s it for us this time! Don’t forget that we love watching your gameplay clips! If you’ve been capturing some nice videos, send them over for a chance to be featured on our social media channels: https://forms.gle/Lj7S9j14vjLfefNi6

notes.title: October 30, 2024 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 🤫

Today we released our third patch since A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead launched nearly two weeks ago. 

If you run into any issues or bugs, please report them to our support team: https://support.saber.games. It really helps us be able to deliver the best game patches to you.

Stay quiet; survive another day. 

Creature Fixes

 Fixed an issue with the creatures perceiving multiple noises at once.
 Fixed an issue where the creature would not react correctly to throwable objects.
 Fixed an issue where the creatures would get stuck (they are not supposed to get stuck).
 Fixed an issue where the creature would disappear for a moment during a sequence in the Hospital. 
 Fixed an issue where the creature disappears for a moment while in its aggressive state in the Pump Station.


General Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the asthma system would stop working while entering the safe zone at the end of the Forest.
 Fixed an issue with a missing collision by the Canal checkpoint at the Pump Station.
 Fixed an issue where the stinger sound effect would play while exiting the “investigation” state.
 Fixed an issue where the asthma visual would remain active even after taking steps to alleviate it.
 Fixed the microphone icon that was showing as unmuted during death sequences.
 Did some optimization work on the raytracing stuttering issue that has been reported on PC.
 Fixed an issue where the game was not launching in full-screen mode for some players on PC.
 Fixed an issue where DLSS was creating artifacts for some PC players.


Quality of Life

 We have added a tutorial panel showing players how to toggle the yellow paint hints on/off for those of you who would like to find your own way through this bleak environment.
 Moved the microphone tutorial panel that shows at the beginning of the game to better explain that there are gameplay moments where the active mic is not being registered.
 Fixed an issue related to the “Art Lover” and “Passionate” achievements for some players who purchased the pre-order content.


Issues with the DualSense microphone on PlayStation 5: 

We have received some feedback about players having issues related to using the microphone on the DualSense controller. Please note that if the "Mute Game Voice Chat" function is active, the game cannot perceive the sounds coming from the DualSense microphone.

For troubleshooting, please make sure that:
The toggle of the setting "Mute Game Voice Chat" is switched to "OFF." 
The DualSense mic is active.
The correct mic perception level on the PS5 DualSense side.
The in-game mic feature is turned on "ON."

Known Issue

We have discovered a rare issue related to RTX and the latest NVIDIA drivers. We are actively investigating this.


That’s it for us this time! Don’t forget that we love watching your gameplay clips! If you’ve been capturing some nice videos, send them over for a chance to be featured on our social media channels: https://forms.gle/Lj7S9j14vjLfefNi6.

notes.title: October 24, 2024 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Be alert silent survivors! 🤫


It’s been an amazing week since the release of A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead, and we’re thrilled by your response so far. Thank you all for diving into the game and sharing your experiences with us!

We’re excited to share that a new patch is now live, bringing both PC and console players up to the same version with all the same fixes. This patch addresses several key issues based on your feedback and we’re continuing to monitor all reports through our support site to make the game even better.

Visual & Art Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the lights were turning off even when standing near a barrel at the beginning of the Fire Station. 
 Fixed an issue where the right-side bridge would shrink at the beginning of the level sequence in the Fire Station. 
 Fixed an issue where some visual artifacts were appearing in a puddle in the garage of the Hospital.
 Fixed an issue where Martin was not stopping in the room with the candles at the Ranch. 
 Fixed an issue where the fire was clipping through the van in the tunnel during the Chase sequence. 
 Fixed an issue where the lamp would disappear from the garden in the Forest. 
 Fixed an issue where Alex's hand would appear floating in the air when climbing down the obstacle near the waterfalls in Trainwreck.
 Improved look of the train cars in the broken rail area of the Trainwreck level.
 Fix an issue where there were floating foliage, floating bridge grates, and compenetrating electrical wires at the Trainwreck.
 Fixed an issue where some leaves in the Lake level were not properly placed on the ground.
 Touched up the asset model for the air vent grates. 
 Fixed an issue where the sprites had inconsistent animations in the game credits.


General Fixes


 Fixed an issue where subtitles would re-enable during the ending sequence in the Prologue. 
 Fixed an issue where the "Lighting" achievement was not being granted regardless of when Alex reached the chapel at the Hospital. If you have done this previously it should be awarded to you automatically. 
 Fixed an issue where Alex could still interact with the training pool door after completing the hide-and-seek mission in the Fire Station. 
 Fixed an issue where Alex could interact with the locker while inside the vent in the Fire Station.
 Fixed an issue where the door would close too quickly in the room with the wooden plank in the Fire Station. 
 Fixed an issue where there was a missing "Need Key" message when standing outside of the cabin in the Campsite. 
 Fixed an issue where the plank found by the house at the pier could be picked up from the outside while at the Harbor. 
 Fixed an issue where the wrong hint was displayed for the electronically locked door while holding a barrel while at the Harbor. 
 Fixed an issue where the "Skip" button during the death strike sequence at the Harbor was hidden behind the black bars that show in Theater Mode during the death strike sequence.
 Fixed an issue where the lit flare was not being dropped as Alex climbs into the vent in the Pump Station.
 Fixed an issue where the hint marker was not updating after Alex climbed into the vent after reaching the safe zone in the Pump Station. 
 Fixed an issue with a door lock disappearing in the Pump Station.
 Fixed a lock that had the bolt without the rest of the mechanism on the cabin door in the artisan’s garden in the Forest. 
 Fixed an issue where blocking Martin from walking in the basement at the Ranch would teleport him to a different place in the same room. 
 Fixed an issue where there was an extra collision placed between the rocks on the way to the notebook at the waterfalls area of the Trainwreck level.
 Fixed an issue where the flare tutorial would briefly appear when opening the tutorial for the Journal. 
 Fixed an issue where defused bottles and tin cans had their physics reenabled throughout the game. 
 Fixed an issue where pressing the fast equip buttons were not triggering a notification that the inventory could not be accessed while inside the air ducts. 
 Fixed an issue where if the player set the “Show Item Callout” option to “Always On” in the game settings, and then went into Survivor Mode, the setting would become greyed out and default to “Only On Request.” 
 Fixed an issue where valves could be picked up while standing on top of them. 
 Fixed an issue where rope traps were placed in the wrong positions.
 Fixed an issue where “normal” movement speed would sometimes register as “slow” movement speed for players. 
 Fixed an issue where head-bobbing while running would continue during animation sequences. running head-bobbing occurred during animation sequences. 
 Fixed inconsistencies with some game world objects whose state would be lost upon reloading that checkpoint. 
 Fixed a typo in the word “trophies” for PlayStation 5.
 Fixed an issue with vertical switching and the selector disappearing while on the Survivor Mode selection screen for Xbox Series X|S.
 Fixed an issue related to the mouse cursor during the key rebinding process for PC. 



Audio Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the soundtrack would stop playing if the player skipped the cutscene before escaping the creatures in the Trainwreck. 
 Adjusted sound volumes throughout the game.
 Removed the high-pitched sound made by the creatures and replaced it with a relatively softer one.
 

Creature Fixes

 Added a missing outro animation for the creature in the garage at the Hospital. 
 Fixed an issue where the creature could be stuck after jumping from the narrow passage in the Pump Station.  
 Fixed an issue where the creature would walk through a burst pipe and not be able to return to the roof of the Pump Station. 
 Fixed an issue with the creature displaying the wrong jump animation in Pump Station. 
 Fixed an issue with the jump animation for the creature at the Pump Station. 
 Fixed an issue where the creature could get stuck near the wooden plank in the Pool area at the Fire Station. 
 Fixed an issue with the creature’s reaction cue after the final sequence in the Trainwreck. 
 Fixed an issue where interactions were disabled when the creature was in aggressive mode.





Don’t forget that we love watching your gameplay clips! If you’ve been capturing some nice videos, send them over for a chance to be featured on our social media channels: https://forms.gle/Lj7S9j14vjLfefNi6 

If you run into any issues or bugs, please report them to our support team: https://support.saber.games/hc/en-us/requests/new It really helps us be able to deliver the best game patches to you.

We hope you have a great experience with these fixes!

notes.title: October 18, 2024 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It’s been incredible watching the reception of A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead over the past 24 hours. Thank you so much for playing!

We have prepared a hotfix to address some of the issues and feedback we have received so far and continue to evaluate everything that is being sent to our support team. This is rolling out on Steam now, with the bottom two headed to consoles at a later date.

Resolved Issues

 Fixed an issue related to Steam players suffering from a performance drop down to 22 FPS.
 Fixed an issue where players could acquire an extra key in their inventory in the Campsite level.

Quality of Life

 Added a toggle option in the settings menu called “Chromatic Aberration.” The default is set to off. 

Aspect Ratio
If you are trying to set an aspect ratio that is different from the monitor you are using, like trying to run the game at 1920x1080 on an ultrawide for example, then you will be unable to see settings for this. This is a stylistic feature of the game to ensure that the gameplay experience is consistent for all players, especially when in “Theatrical Mode.”

Yellow Paint
We’ve seen some players comment that they would prefer to play without the aid of yellow paint hints. Good news! This feature can be disabled by selecting the settings menu > Gameplay > Interface > “Remove Yellow Paints.”

PC Recommended Requirements
We have created an infographic (below) to outline what your expected settings and performance should be for your set-up. Please take a look if you have been experiencing any performance issues, as adjusting your settings per this chart may help to resolve this issue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063969/efb4c71a775cd58e3931d2a5dc4cc9eaae8e00ad.jpg

We love watching your gameplay clips! If you’ve been capturing some nice video, send them over for a chance to be featured on our social media channels: https://forms.gle/Lj7S9j14vjLfefNi6. 

If you run into any issues or bugs, please report them to our support team: https://support.saber.games.

Thanks again for joining us for the release of A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead, we hope you have a great weekend!
